basic_profile.bio: A tech-savvy individual with a passion for new gadgets and smart home technologies. Based in Austin, Texas, I work as a freelance audio engineer and spend my free time exploring the latest trends in LED lighting and music synchronization. I dislike cluttered interfaces and products that lack user-friendly controls. Typically online in the evenings, I enjoy engaging with communities that share my interests. Currently single, I often find myself testing out new tech with my friends who share similar hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in electrical engineering, which I pursued at the University of Texas. My expertise in LED technologies and music synchronization comes from both my formal education and my professional experience in the audio industry, where I frequently integrate lighting solutions in live performances.
